name: – Daniel Freund – § 20, point x – Am 49
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section III – Commission and executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: (x) focus on policies that reduce the cost of living including fuel and energy prices instead of wasting time and resources on gender budgeting and tracking the impact of the Union budget in fostering gender equality;
